descriptions.d24f_record_vector_append_all_803466fc: Appends every 16-byte record (halfword, word, table 0x804104e0, shared string) of the source vector to this vector, growing through 0x80212fd4/0x803413d8 when full and destroying the old strings before releasing storage via 0x802134fc. Then destroys the source records and empties the source vector.
